title: No Smelting Iron
description: Slow down progression on your server by making iron ingots unobtainable from smelting and crafting.
body:
# Instructions:
To disable iron from being craftable:
1. Put the datapack in your datapack folder
2. Run the command ```/datapack enable "file/NoSmeltingIron.zip"``` as OP.
3. Run the command ```/reload``` as OP.

To make iron craftable again:
1. Run the command ```/datapack disable "file/NoSmeltingIron.zip"``` as OP.
2. Run the command ```/reload``` as OP.

You have to manually add/remove the mod version to control iron being smelted.
## Purpose:

The purpose of this data pack is for progression control.

Makes iron ingots (minecraft:iron\_ingot) unobtainable from the following sources:

* Smelting any kind of iron ore (Smelting never starts)
* Crafting ingots from iron nuggets
* Smelting existing iron tools and armour back into nuggets


**This datapack does NOT:**

* Remove iron tools or ingots from structure loot pools
* Remove iron tools or ingots from monster loot pools
* Remove iron tools or ingots from world generation.
